Overview

San Carlos de Bariloche is a city in Río Negro with a population of 146,000. Patagonia’s alpine paradise in the Lake District with skiing, chocolate, and stunning mountain lakes. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
